name: Kaguraya Akito
source:
A regular customer of "Oukaya" who works as a broker, infamous for his lack of sympathy and mercy. It seems like he doesn't like the heroine and always treats her coldly, but the reason is a mystery.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/11/19/yoshiwara-higanbana/]Otome Jikan's character profile translations[/URL].]
